slides.h: ANIMALS REVIEWED [[DIETS]]. THE DOG ATE THE {{MEAL PLAN}}.
slides.tease: **Cheat day became a lifestyle.** The cat watched one almond become lunch.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.title: WOULD CHEAT AGAIN
slides.body: Started Monday. Cheat day Tuesday. Cheat week Wednesday. The plan is now a lifestyle and the lifestyle is snacks.

slides.name: The Owl
slides.title: Scientifically bankrupt
slides.body: Surveyed the celery juice studies. There are none. The owl drank it anyway and would like that stricken from the record.

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.title: Carbs are a superfood
slides.body: Bread crumbs daily, eaten confidently in front of a spin class. Zero regrets. Look at me. This physique is bread.

slides.name: The Goldfish
slides.title: Forgot to be hungry
slides.body: Intermittent fasting is easy when meals slip your mind. Remembered food at 4PM. Ate everything. Restarted the app.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.title: Balance, apparently
slides.body: Watched a human eat one almond and call it lunch. Then watched the same human eat a cake and call it balance. Case closed.
Tag the friend who starts every diet on a Monday.
